purpose.primary: Passively classify KMI product families from OS-reported MIDI port names before opening any ports.
secondary: Choose safe probe ports for single-client MIDI backends
Confirm exact product identity from SysEx replies
Resolve editor module, bootloader command, and firmware payload selection

notes: The first Windows port often reports only the product string.
Additional legacy ports may appear as MIDIINn or MIDIOUTn entries derived from the product string.
Names with trailing instance numbers are Windows-added artifacts and should normalize to the base product string.
Use exact equality only after normalization; never use partial matching.
